svg.title: Snow line: Aerial reconnaissance photo
svg.desc: Snow line (2D): the yard crossing seen as a grainy aerial reconnaissance print. Fisk is a dark dot with a breath plume, heading for the kennel shed at the top; behind him a trail of sharp boot prints stays in the snow, older ones softening. A lamp patrol has found the trail and turns to follow it, while the searchlight circle sweeps its loop between him and the wire.
